## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2e90f2c9294845ee2720b293629deebc4292ba11`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx (`raiseRefusal`, the banner ref and scroll, the three refusal points), ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx (`saveRefusalLines`, `refusedCellsOf`, `saveError` as lines, `cellErrors` per row key and its clears, the refusal row, the cell marks, the toolbar slot), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridInlineRules.ts (new, not exported from the package), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx (`inlineRuleRefusal` in `defaultRowSave` and `saveRowsClaimed`, the toolbar inset), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridTranslations.ts (`validation.*` defaults), the two new test files and the twelve adapted pins, .changeset/27520-refused-grid-and-form-saves.md

Inputs: card #27520 (rows 6 and 19 of the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough; the seat's claim 6541435370 and its amendment 6541672013 after the live measure, which adds `data-table.tsx` and `form.tsx` to the surface and rules the behaviour: a refused submit shows one message, the banner, scrolled into view, no toast; the #13340 pin adapted with its no-stacking guarantee kept; the toast stays where no banner is drawn), PR #28396 (body with the live before and after on showcase and a `t27520_widget` object, the acceptance notes, the file list of 20 files, the diff of 955 lines against `main` read whole for every hand-written hunk, 5 commits from the merge-base), the 55 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T11:10Z: all 55 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Test Core, Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Build Core, Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Plan Test Core shards, Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Test Core (matrix shard/8), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head for `@object-ui/react` `error-message.ts` (`extractFieldErrors` :219, `unmarkedRefusalLines` :279, the readers `form.tsx` already uses), `@object-ui/fields` `buildValidationRules` (the rule emitter the record form checks through), the `validation.*` keys of the `@object-ui/i18n` en pack beside the new `objectGridTranslations.ts` defaults (same eight keys, same strings), and the #13340 pin before this PR (banner plus one toast under the outcome id, the toast "for when the banner has scrolled out of view"). The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main`; the app-shell files that moved on `main` since the merge-base (#28392) are outside this PR's files.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Row 19 reverses #13340 by the seat's ruling, and keeps what #13340 was for** - right. The toast existed for a banner a long modal or drawer form had scrolled out of view; `raiseRefusal` now dismisses any outcome toast, sets the banner, and scrolls it into view (`block: 'nearest'`) on every raise, so the one message is the one the user sees. All three refusal points (a `visibleWhen` fault, `onAction`'s `result.error`, a thrown write) go through it, and every refusal path of this renderer draws the banner, so the ruling's "toast stays where no banner is drawn" case has no instance here. The adapted pin holds one banner, scrolled, zero error toasts, and a refused retry that keeps one banner and scrolls again; the eleven sibling pins that asserted the toast now assert the banner and no toast. Nothing is deleted, as the seat conditioned.
- **Row 6 says every reason whole and marks the cells the refusal names** - right. The refusal is its own `role="alert"` row under the toolbar, one line per reason from the same `unmarkedRefusalLines` reader the form uses (falling back to the error's message), deduplicated across rows; the cells come from `extractFieldErrors` keyed by row key, drawn as `aria-invalid`, `data-cell-error`, `title` and an inset ring. A mark leaves when its cell is edited again, when its row saves, on Cancel and on Cancel All; a whole-batch rejection, whose fields belong to no known row, marks nothing and says its reasons. A field with no column marks nothing and its reason is still said.
- **The pre-send check judges the field's own rules and nothing more** - right. `inlineEditRuleRefusals` reads each changed field's declaration through `buildValidationRules`, the record form's own emitter: `required` on a blank value, `min` / `max` on a staged number or number string, `minLength` / `maxLength` and the email / URL pattern on text; an authored message wins, else the `validation.*` key with the header's label. A missing declaration or an unreadable rule set judges nothing, so the server stays the judge of everything else (validation rules, uniqueness, state machines). A refused row takes the server's own shape (`code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`, `fields[]`), so the table marks and says it the same way; in `saveRowsClaimed` the refused row is never sent and the other rows still go, each its own outcome. A host's `onRowSave` / `onBatchSave` is untouched.
- **The declarations are right** - `Clause-②: no`: `objectGridInlineRules.ts` is not exported from `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, no renderer or hook gains a member, no accept set moves; `Metadata-protocol: none`: no spec path. A reversed visible behaviour is this record's reason to exist, not a surface change.
- **Pins both ways** - right. Eleven new cases (four on the table's refusal row and marks, seven on the grid's pre-send check over the real `ObjectGrid` and `data-table`, with a control edit inside the rules that is sent), the #13340 pin adapted, the twelve sibling pins moved to the banner; the first run's 25 reds (an unreadable rule set) are what f77d7968 fixed, and the rerun and CI are green.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch** - accepted. Behaviour fixes with no exported surface moved; the changeset names the reversal of the one-error-toast behaviour for a host that pinned it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **A host pinned on the refusal toast** - the changeset says the toast is gone; a host that watched `toast.error` for a form refusal reads the banner now. That is the reversal the seat ruled and the card asked for; no further line owed.
- **Row 19's field mark for a `script` rule** - cannot be drawn: the spec gives a script rule no `fields`, so the server names `_record`. Recorded on the card, not filed; a spec card if an author ever needs a script rule to name a field.
- **The pre-send check covers the built-in saves only** - a host supplying its own save owns its checking, as the body says.
- **Partial landing** - `Part of #27520`; rows 7, 9, 12, 14, 17 and 21 stay on the card.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 955 lines), no human gate; no name approval owed.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: a number field edited to a non-numeric string (`numericValue` answers undefined, so min / max do not judge and the server does); a `required` field cleared to an empty array (blank, refused as required); a refusal naming a field the row did not edit (marked where drawn, which is right: the server's answer is the truth); a batch where two rows fail the same rule (one deduplicated line in the bar, each row's cell marked). Judging through the same emitter the form uses is what keeps the grid and the form from disagreeing on a rule. Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The form says a refusal once and brings that one message into view, which is the case the retired toast existed for; the grid says every reason whole, marks the cells the refusal names and clears them on edit or save; the pre-send check judges the field's own rules through the form's own emitter and leaves everything else to the server with the refused row unsent and the others saved; the declarations and the patch level are right; the pins are adapted not deleted and hold both ways; and every check on this head is green or skipped.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-mcx7eo`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:ui#1` · head `2e90f2c9` · 2026-10-31T11:11Z

席位意见：在表格里批量编辑后点「全部保存」，如果服务器拒绝，保存栏现在完整列出每一条原因，一条一行，不再截断；被拒绝的单元格会标出来，改动该单元格后标记消失。表格自带的保存在发送前会先检查必填、最小值/最大值、长度和格式：不通过的行不发送，其余行照常保存。「全部保存」按钮离右边缘留出 12 像素。表单保存被拒绝时只显示一条消息，就是表单顶部的横幅，并自动滚动到可见处，不再同时弹出内容相同的 toast。

1. **Shape:** `Part of #27520` (rows 6 and 19), draft, base `main`, 20 files, +814/−141. Changes:
   - `data-table.tsx`: the refusal shown in full as lines, cell marks per row key, the inset toolbar slot.
   - `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus the new module-private `objectGridInlineRules.ts`: the pre-send check, through `buildValidationRules`.
   - `objectGridTranslations.ts`: `validation.*` defaults.
   - `form.tsx`: `raiseRefusal`, the banner ref and scroll.
   - Two new test files, twelve adapted pins and a changeset.
2. **Seat read:** the surface matches amendment 6541672013. The #13340, MasterDetailForm, WizardForm and single-raiser pins are adapted, not deleted. They pin one banner, zero error toasts and no stacking on a retry. Every refusal path of the form renderer draws the banner, so the "keep the toast without a banner" case has no instance. A `script` rule names only `_record`, so it has nothing to mark. That is recorded, not filed. Lint UI was red at `f77d7968` on an unused `waitFor` import, and `2e90f2c9` fixes it.
3. **Contract review:** PASS 6542621536 on this head. ② is patch for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, and the changeset names the toast reversal. ③ found no name approval owed. The pre-send check covers only the built-in saves; a host's own save does its own checking.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** on `2e90f2c9`: 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure, including Test UI (all 16) and Lint UI. `mergeable_state` clean.
5. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28396` reports NOT governed, 955 changed lines ≤ 3000. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge, on the maintainer's 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (seat thread, 2026-10-30T14:19Z).
